'''Unagin''' was a minor [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It was located within the [[Unagin system/Legends|Unagin system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Al'Nasrl sector/Legends|Al'Nasrl sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Hollastin Run/Legends|Hollastin Run]], which connected it to the worlds of [[Tsyk]] and [[Syvris/Legends|Syvris]]. A smaller [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route also connected Unagin to the planet [[Riileb/Legends|Riileb]]. Due to Unagin's location near [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that prepared to enter or leave that region frequently stopped at the planet.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Unagin was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the planet in grid square T-13.<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was set to appear in ''[[Adventures in Hyperspace: The Big Switch]]'', a young-readers book written by [[Ryder Windham]]. However, that book was postponed and eventually canceled.<ref name="BigSwitch">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarstimeline.net/AdventuresinHyperspace.htm|text=Star Wars Adventures in Hyperspace Book 3 The Big Switch|author=Eddie van der Heijden|date=2015-04-22|work=[http://www.starwarstimeline.net The Star Wars Expanded Universe Timeline]|archivedate=20190913095410}}</ref><ref name="Scholastic">{{Scholastic|domain=ca|url=booksellers/catalogues/fall2010/Fall2010_PB.pdf|text=Scholastic Paperback Books Fall 2010}} {{C|Page 28}}</ref>

===''Adventures in Hyperspace: The Big Switch''===
{{Cutstart}}
[[File:Boost_hanchewie.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Han Solo and Chewbacca would have visited Unagin in the canceled book ''Adventures in Hyperspace: The Big Switch''.]]
At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="date">According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] acquired the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], and left [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] employ and became involved with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Therefore, since ''[[Adventures in Hyperspace: The Big Switch]]'' depicts Han Solo in Jabba's employ before he has joined the Alliance, the events of that story must occur at some point between these two dates.</ref> the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[art dealer]] [[Itto Bipsmik]] lived with her two children in a small [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] settlement that was located near a [[Tree/Legends|wooded]] area in Unagin's southern hemisphere. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], she sold the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] a portrait bust of Jabba's ancestor [[Bogga]], which she kept in a storage shelter near the compound's landing site, and Jabba hired the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], to retrieve the sculpture on Unagin, where Bipsmik resided, and bring it to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="BigSwitch" />

Arriving on Unagin in their [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the smugglers met Bipsmik at the edge of the settlement, in a large compound of structures bordered by a [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]] wall; however, their meeting was interrupted by the arrival of [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rench]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] captain ordered the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] accompanying him to destroy the bust and subsequently left Unagin.<ref name="BigSwitch" />

Luckily for Solo, Bipsmik had made a perfect replica of the sculpture that she stored in her garage. Solo intended to deliver the replica to Jabba, hoping that the Hutt would not notice the difference. After discovering a [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] that Rench had planted aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'' and evading the captain's [[Imperial Customs Corvette|light corvette]] in Unagin's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], the smuggling duo left the planet for Tatooine.<ref name="BigSwitch" />
{{Cutend}}
